comments.text: In the year 2026 $20.00 an hour will not cut it in the United States Of A Corporation! It is not that people are lazy it’s the fact that it’s no joke out here and people are tired of working but not being able to afford nothing. You barely qualify for an apartment with $20.00 an hour especially when you have to make 3 times the rent to even qualify for a dam apartment in many places in the U.S. In the year 1999 $20.00 an hour may have worked but NOT in the year 2026. This madness is all by design.
